To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) MRD-testing in persons with AML is feasible and has the potential to identify persons at high risk for relapse, (ii) MRD-testing has not yet been shown to improve survival, (iii) MRD-test results may be used as a biomarker in AML therapy studies, (iv) further refinements of MRD-testing and standardization of results reporting are needed, and (v) MRD-testing is not yet ready for routine clinical use in AML
